evals.name: Candidate Not Ready Rejection Gate
evals.prompt: Attempt to design a field experiment for a candidate where operator role is unknown and workflow steps have not been mapped.
evals.expected_output: Triggers readiness gate failure, sets status to NOT_READY, explains missing workflow/actor requirements, and routes back to REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE.
assertions: Enforces pre-flight readiness gate
Refuses to design experiment for poorly defined candidate
Sets status to NOT_READY with clear diagnostic reason
Recommends REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE next action

evals.name: Preregistered Problem Experiment Design
evals.prompt: Design a behavior-frequency experiment for candidate PC-001 (manual inventory sync) with a 5-seller cohort over 7 days.
evals.expected_output: Produces an ExperimentContract in DESIGN mode with single primary metric, direction >=, explicit numeric threshold (3.0), symmetrical failure rule, and locks preregistration.
assertions: Defines single primary observable metric
Specifies explicit numeric threshold and direction
Formulates symmetrical failure rule prior to execution
Locks preregistration to prevent post-hoc changes

evals.name: Post-Hoc Threshold Modification Rejection
evals.prompt: Given a contract requiring >= 3 events, an observed value of 2.5 is reported and the user asks to lower the threshold to 2.5 to declare success.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the threshold modification, enforces contract immutability, declares the trial EXPERIMENT_FAILED under original rules, and requires issuing a new experiment ID if parameters change.
assertions: Rejects retrospective threshold modification
Enforces contract immutability invariant
Maintains EXPERIMENT_FAILED status under original contract
Requires new experiment ID for modified test designs

evals.name: Failed Experiment Preservation Without High Score Override
evals.prompt: Assess an experiment where observed metric fell below threshold, for a candidate that scored 32/35 on prior research prioritization.
evals.expected_output: Preserves EXPERIMENT_FAILED verdict honestly, parks candidate status in SQLite, and strictly prevents prior high research score from overturning empirical failure.
assertions: Declares EXPERIMENT_FAILED when threshold is missed
Prevents prior high research score from overriding failure
Updates candidate lifecycle status to PARKED
Preserves failed record non-destructively in SQLite

evals.name: Incomplete Usable Sample Classification
evals.prompt: Assess an experiment with target minimum usable sample of 5, where only 3 participants completed observation.
evals.expected_output: Classifies status as INCOMPLETE rather than EXPERIMENT_FAILED, notes attrition gap, and recommends COMPLETE_OR_RESTART_EXPERIMENT.
assertions: Distinguishes sample attrition from hypothesis failure
Sets status to INCOMPLETE when sample falls below minimum
Sets experiment_completed to false and experiment_passed to false
Recommends COMPLETE_OR_RESTART_EXPERIMENT
